signals_info.description: Ego-vehicle speed while approaching the relevant traffic light.

nl_Literal_translation_en: For the next 5 seconds, the ego vehicle speed shall remain below 50 kilometers per hour.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在接下来的 5 秒内，自车速度应始终低于 50 千米每小时。
nl_Paraphrase_en: During the 5-second traffic-light approach window, the vehicle shall continuously remain below 50 km/h.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在 5 秒的信号灯接近区间内，车辆速度应持续低于 50 千米每小时。
